question: im a junior commuter who works part time, which club should i join to help me get an internship
answer:
If you’re interested in accounting, the Accounting Club is the clearest match: its advisors encourage internships, and members attend networking and leadership events with professionals. It’s a Student Organization: https://archway.ramapo.edu/Accounting/ [6][10] Email accountclub@ramapo.edu. [10] All clubs listed on the college’s club page are open to all students. [14]

Women in Business is another possibility: it is open to all students and offers mentorship, business connections, and help navigating future job applications. Email wib@ramapo.edu. [13] The pages don’t give meeting times, so I can’t verify which club fits your work schedule. For club information, contact the Center for Student Involvement, csi@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7593. [14]

For internship searching, the Cahill Career Development Center says a career advisor can provide job-search help and Handshake resources; you still need to interview and get the job yourself. Handshake can also be used to find co-op internships. [17] Contact careercenter@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7444. [17]

Sources: [6](https://archway.ramapo.edu/Accounting/) [10](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/accounting-club/) [13](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/women-in-business/) [14](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/) [17](https://www.ramapo.edu/careercenter/get-started/)
